decisions.reason: Because C survived the first review while other nearby carpet launches were cut, it likely meets aspiration levels better than those peers, and with portfolio overlap now reduced there is no strong trigger for problemistic search away from it.
The corner bench is tightly aligned with the firm's core furniture and project business, so in the absence of evidence of a clear aspiration shortfall management would typically continue it.

The swivel shell chair line spans several models and customer uses, which supports learning and sales potential above aspiration and makes withdrawal less likely while organizational slack appears sufficient.
